lifecycle_contract.output_bound: deflateBound on configured live encoder; bounds above UINT_MAX are unsupported
lifecycle_contract.return_length: Actual total_out deltas for update and finish; capacity is never charged
lifecycle_contract.error_codes: Stable tscb_status_v1; capacity exhaustion is DST_TOO_SMALL; malformed/truncated/nonexact streams are CODEC_ERROR
lifecycle_contract.update: One deflate call with Z_NO_FLUSH and complete input consumption
lifecycle_contract.finalize: Loop deflate with Z_FINISH until Z_STREAM_END; repeated finalize rejected
lifecycle_contract.decode: Fresh inflateInit2 context; inflate must reach Z_STREAM_END, consume all input and produce the exact descriptor length
lifecycle_contract.reset: NEW_CONTEXT_PER_INDEPENDENT_OBJECT; C ABI reset reinitializes encoder and clears timing counters

stream_components.outer_container: TSCB 12-byte prefix and canonical JSON buffer descriptors
stream_components.header: Two RFC1950 CMF/FLG bytes charged to container_bits
stream_components.payload: All RFC1951 bytes charged to routed data bucket, including internal bit padding
stream_components.checksum: Four Adler32 bytes charged to checksum_bits

known_limitations: lzbench calls compress2/uncompress one-shot. The project uses the same vendored implementation through Z_NO_FLUSH/Z_FINISH to expose mandatory Finalize; native timing is not lzbench-equivalent.

Registered defaults: level 6, windowBits 15, memLevel 8, default strategy, one CPU thread, no preset dictionary, mandatory Adler32. Raw DEFLATE, gzip, dictionaries, strategies, memLevel sweeps, parallelism and streaming workloads are not registered.
A zlib stream does not store uncompressed length. Independent allocation uses the TSCB descriptor, not encoder state.
The single-update ABI accepts input and output capacities at most UINT_MAX; deflateBound above UINT_MAX is unsupported.
The benchmark-vendored tree is 1.3.2; the comparison-only upstream checkout e3dc0a85b7032e98380dec011bc8f2c2ee0d8fca is 1.3.2.1 and differs. No sources are mixed or automatically upgraded.
LeakSanitizer is disabled under the host ptrace policy; ASan/UBSan remain enabled.
